business_problem: Gorilla Glue needed to replace decades-old finance and supply chain systems plus numerous bolt-on tools so it could support global expansion, automate manual processes, and create a single real-time view of costs, inventory, demand, and profitability.
solution_summary: The Gorilla Glue Company standardized finance, planning, procurement, and supply chain work on Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, EPM, and SCM, then layered Oracle Fusion ERP Analytics, Fusion SCM Analytics, and Oracle Procurement on top for insight and supplier collaboration. Transactions that once depended on paper processes, spreadsheets, and disconnected legacy software now flow through one cloud suite with a common data model. Oracle Cloud ERP provides structured financial reporting and account analysis, EPM adds scenario modeling and what-if planning, SCM modernizes inventory and operational planning, and Procurement creates a supplier portal with standardized contracting and performance management. Because the analytics services read from the same integrated transaction set, teams can analyze profitability by product and customer, assess the impact of promotions or price changes, and plan global expansion from one governed system instead of stitching together bolt-ons and offline files.
products_used: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Performance Management (EPM)
Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain & Manufacturing (SCM)

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
solution_components.role: Runs Gorilla Glue's core financial processes and improved chart of accounts on a shared global platform.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Performance Management (EPM)
solution_components.role: Provides scenario modeling, planning, and budgeting on top of the integrated enterprise dataset.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain & Manufacturing (SCM)
solution_components.role: Standardizes supply chain, inventory, and operational planning processes across the business.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion ERP Analytics
solution_components.role: Surfaces financial and profitability insight from the consolidated enterprise data source.

solution_components.name: Fusion SCM Analytics
solution_components.role: Provides operational analytics over the integrated supply chain and planning environment.

solution_components.name: Oracle Procurement
solution_components.role: Creates a supplier portal and standardized supplier-management processes within the cloud suite.

data_flow: Finance, planning, supply chain, and supplier data now flows through Oracle Fusion ERP, EPM, SCM, and Procurement instead of paper forms and spreadsheets; Oracle Fusion ERP Analytics and Fusion SCM Analytics then read from that common model to support profitability, planning, and supplier-performance analysis.
business_outcome: Gorilla Glue simplified its technology estate, improved financial and operational visibility, automated routine work, and built a common data foundation for global expansion, product profitability analysis, and better supplier and inventory management.
architecture_clues: Shared cloud data model links ERP, EPM, SCM, analytics, and procurement
Supplier portal is integrated into the same enterprise platform
Scenario modeling and what-if analysis are run directly on actuals and historical cloud ERP data
evidence_quotes: The company ultimately selected the unified suite of Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), and Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain & Manufacturing (SCM).
The system also automated routine processes like transaction matching and payment reconciliations.
A consolidated financial data source, Oracle Fusion Analytics, also allowed for more strategic analysis into areas including profitability by product and customer.
